ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) clusters and streaks. Estimated dark-to-light pixel distribution ratio of 4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks and circular spots are non-uniformly distributed across a dark base. High-intensity pixel density increases significantly at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible deep V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a defined vertex and symmetrical diverging edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks and valleys (3-12 pixel amplitude) extracted along the entire horizontal boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating from the peduncle and extending to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel blobs detected at the distal tips and in the lower-central regions of both fluke lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations intersecting across the primary dark pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring network composed of linear rake marks and circular rosette scars; noticeable irregular jaggedness at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense 'criss-cross' pattern of white linear abrasions against the dark ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the inner halves of both lobes.
